name: Media Strip
author: Felipe Oliboni
description: Now-playing bar widget with album art and playback controls for Omarchy 4. Right-click for appearance options.

barWidget.description: Shows the current track inline in the bar, with a popup for album art, progress and transport controls. Right-click for appearance options (album art, icon, label width).

schema.label: Show album art in the bar
schema.description: Small cover thumbnail next to the track name. Same thing as right-click → Show album art.

schema.label: Show music icon in the bar
schema.description: Play/pause note before the track name. Same thing as right-click → Show music icon.

schema.label: Widget width
schema.description: Maximum width, in pixels, of the track label in the bar before it elides. Same thing as right-click → Widget width.

schema.label: Album art size
schema.description: Cover size, in pixels, inside the Now Playing popup.

schema.label: Show track progress
schema.description: Elapsed/total time and a seek bar in the Now Playing popup.

schema.label: Show source picker
schema.description: Lists the other running players at the bottom of the Now Playing popup.

schema.label: Spotify accent
schema.description: Tint the popup's accent Spotify green while Spotify is the active player.
